title: Bel Elan Fitness Studio - CGI Launch, Branding and Social Media Management
description: Bel Elan launched its ladies fitness studio in Kuwait with Astroshot through a CGI launch campaign, full brand development, print materials, and one year of social media management. The launch CGI video generated 1M+ organic views across Instagram and TikTok while positioning the studio as a high-end destination for Pilates, dance classes, and women’s fitness.
